description: scripts/init-consumer.mjs planTemplate() treats any existing scaffold file as a successful 'exists' skip whenever force is false, regardless of whether the existing content matches the template. The architecture step 6 explicitly says 'refuses scaffold template targets ... that already exist with conflicting content unless force === true' and only existence-with-identical-content is a no-op skip. Today a half-set-up consumer with a malformed plans/overview-data.js silently passes init with ok: true and filesSkipped = ['plans/overview-data.js: exists'], masking a broken state. Matches plan-review finding F-019 and was flagged High by both Codex and Copilot; promoted to High via 3-way consensus.
suggestedFix: Compare existing-file content against the template (read both, normalize newlines if needed). Skip on identical content; refuse with errors.push(`${target}: conflicting content, pass force to overwrite`) when the file exists but differs. Add a test case for the conflict path.
